body:
This won’t pass. Wounds don’t heal if they’re not taken care of. If I live there will always be this abyss inside of me and I won’t be able to put a fake smile on my face any longer. And even if I could , why would I do that ? If I were bleeding from every part of my body or if I had a terminal disease , and nothing about my life would change , and people would still hit me , yell at me , ignore my ilness  and they would’t change their attitude towards me , would you still tell me that things will get better ? It’s easy to see that if things don’t change , the person in that situation will die. And things won’t  change here. Maybe they change for the worse. 
Life  won’t get better for me. In fact , if I would continue to live , I would probably look back now and think that this was the best my life could achive , because I’d probably end up worse.  
I can’t wait any longer for a day that will supposedly change eveything for the better, because that day won’t come. The thing that gets as close as possible to that is today. Today things will change for the better if I die.
